prompt:
Use case: product-mockup
Asset type: transparent photographic cutout for a fictional homeware catalog and educational before/after comparison.
Primary request: a believable studio product photograph of a single matte charcoal-black ceramic pitcher, approximately one litre, with a rounded body, short pouring lip, and a large open loop handle. Three-quarter front view; the entire pitcher including handle and base must be visible, centered with comfortable transparent margins.
Scene/backdrop: genuinely transparent background, including the opening inside the loop handle. No table, backdrop, scenery, or floor. A very soft compact semitransparent contact shadow directly beneath the base is acceptable.
Style/medium: photorealistic commissioned catalog photography; real stoneware texture and subtle handmade variation, restrained highlights, crisp natural edges.
Lighting: soft neutral studio illumination, enough modeling to show the rounded body, charcoal surface stays dark rather than silver or white.
Text: none.
Constraints: one pitcher only, empty, no hands, props, labels, logo, watermark, border, graphic design, or checkerboard pixels. Preserve actual alpha transparency. Do not render a white rectangle behind the object.
composition: The identical transparent product image is composited over two flat native SVG backdrops. Typography is authored separately.
limitations: Illustrative fictional pitcher; stated capacity, product details and price are example copy rather than verified product specifications.
